Technical experience

My work spans full-stack software, cloud platforms, data and AI, with a foundation in systems engineering, telecommunications and media delivery. This is the technology experience behind my projects and career history.

Software & product engineering

TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, PHP, C/C++, Go, Java, Perl, SQL, Bash and PowerShell.

Node.js, Express.js, Laravel, Django, Flask, Spring Boot, React, Angular and Vue.js; React Native, Flutter and Capacitor for mobile. HTML, CSS, XML and XSLT.

Cloud & platforms

AWS, Azure and Google Cloud; Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, MicroK8s and Docker.

Terraform and Ansible; serverless functions, cloud object storage, VMware and OpenStack. Service platforms using Istio, Knative and Envoy.

Data & AI

PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and ClickHouse; ETL, data pipelines, Kafka, Spark, Redshift, Snowflake and BigQuery. Geospatial work with PostGIS, QGIS and GeoPandas.

OpenAI workflows, LLM integration, agentic systems, RAG, model routing and evaluation; TensorFlow, PyTorch and scikit-learn. Predictive modelling, neural networks and Bayesian methods.

APIs, identity & architecture

REST, GraphQL and MCP; OAuth2, OIDC, SSO, OTP, Keycloak and multi-tenant identity.

Enterprise, solution and integration architecture; microservices and distributed systems. Network security, security review and ISO 27001-aligned delivery.

Delivery & operations

GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, CI/CD, release automation and release governance.

Jest, JUnit, Selenium and Playwright; accessibility testing. OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Alloy, Sentry and Splunk, with structured logging, tracing, incident response and production diagnostics.

Systems, networks & media

Linux, Unix, BSD, Windows and macOS; systems administration, TCP/IP, WAN, SDN and NFVi.

Telecommunications, CDN and IPTV platforms; DWDM, DOCSIS, VoIP, GSM and SS7. Media delivery using RTSP, RTMP, HLS and adaptive-bitrate streaming, with enterprise storage and broadcast platforms.
